The decisive mistake was the initial plan in Step 1. The verb "Maktay" means "is pleasing to," so the person doing the liking is the object, which takes the accusative "Mato," and the thing liked is the subject, which takes the nominative "Apple." The correct sentence is therefore "Maktay Mato Apple." The plan instead put "Zapple" (accusative) in the object slot and "Mato" in the subject slot, which reverses the grammatical roles. Step 2 and the termination step only checked the output against the word order and accepted it, so they did not cause the error.
